title: SNMP — Site Detail
description: Tier 1: health, inventory, topology edges, interface errors, and BGP for one site. Use the Site control; open Device Faceplate for a switch.

data_source.query: FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE network.site == ?site AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `Devices at site` = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name)

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE network.site == ?site AND host.type == "switch" AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND STARTS_WITH(interface.name, "Eth") AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL port_key = CONCAT(host.name, ":", interface.name) | STATS oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY port_key | WHERE oper == "up" | STATS `Ports up` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE network.site == ?site AND host.type == "switch" AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND STARTS_WITH(interface.name, "Eth") AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL port_key = CONCAT(host.name, ":", interface.name) | STATS oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY port_key | WHERE oper == "down" | STATS `Ports down` = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE network.site == ?site AND bgp_peer.peer_state IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS state = LAST(bgp_peer.peer_state, @timestamp) BY host.name, bgp_peer.remote_ip | WHERE state != "Established" | STATS `BGP peers down` = COUNT(*)
FROM snmp-topology | WHERE doc_type == "edge" AND site == ?site | KEEP source, target, link_status | SORT link_status DESC, source, target

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE network.site == ?site AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS role = LAST(network.role, @timestamp), vendor = LAST(observer.vendor, @timestamp), oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY host.name, host.type, interface.name | STATS ports_down = COUNT(CASE(oper == "down" AND STARTS_WITH(interface.name, "Eth"), 1, null)), role = MAX(role), vendor = MAX(vendor) BY host.name, host.type | SORT host.type, host.name
FROM snmp-topology | WHERE doc_type == "node" AND site == ?site | KEEP host.name, ports_down, oper_status | SORT ports_down DESC, host.name

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE network.site == ?site AND `interface.errors.in` IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS errors = SUM(COALESCE(`interface.errors.in`, 0) + COALESCE(`interface.errors.out`, 0)) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 30, ?_tstart, ?_tend), host.name

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE network.site == ?site AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL iface = CONCAT(host.name, " · ", interface.name) | STATS err_in = LAST(`interface.errors.in`, @timestamp), err_out = LAST(`interface.errors.out`, @timestamp) BY iface | EVAL errs = COALESCE(err_in, 0) + COALESCE(err_out, 0) | WHERE errs > 0 | SORT errs DESC | LIMIT 10

config.title: BGP peers (CHI eBGP Idle is the story)

data_source.query: FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE network.site == ?site AND bgp_peer.peer_state IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS peer_state = LAST(bgp_peer.peer_state, @timestamp), remote_asn = LAST(bgp_peer.remote_asn, @timestamp), prefixes_rx = LAST(bgp_peer.prefixes_received, @timestamp) BY host.name, bgp_peer.remote_ip | SORT peer_state, host.name

FROM logs-snmp.topology-default | WHERE network.site == ?site AND host.type == "switch" AND interface.name IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS admin = LAST(interface.status.admin, @timestamp), oper = LAST(interface.status.oper, @timestamp) BY host.name, interface.name | WHERE oper == "down" | SORT host.name, interface.name

config.content: **Navigate:** [← US Sites Overview](#/view/snmp-tier0-us-map) · [Device Faceplate →](#/view/snmp-tier2-device-faceplate) — set **Device** to a switch from the inventory (try `hq-access-sw-03` or `nyc-sw-02`).
